steps.title: Create a fresh root account through the testnet faucet
steps.expect: the account exists and is funded
steps.got: loud-mwet47mba97e26.testnet holds 10.0000 NEAR (faucet helper.nearprotocol.com); the run needs 6.9647; the faucet returned transaction 39h6PC5igJpub89ckdeTBEjf18HU7Yn423WoyLidHXjE for the account creation, recorded below as returned

steps.title: Create, fund, deploy and initialise the token account in one transaction with no access key
steps.expect: view_access_key_list returns an empty list; the on-chain code hash equals the hash of the built wasm; get_params equals the preset
steps.got: t.loud-mwet47mba97e26.testnet has 0 access keys; code hash on chain DbBsmR99EGkC95N8vWjmX3vS3zuNVWJyjh7RUBNMWyFQ equals the hash of the built wasm DbBsmR99EGkC95N8vWjmX3vS3zuNVWJyjh7RUBNMWyFQ; get_params equals the demo preset (cap_units 5000000 LOUD per 600s)

steps.title: Create the insider, 20 split wallets and one late buyer under the root
The insider buys with 1 NEAR during the loud window
steps.expect: the bought tokens are loud; quiet balance is 0

steps.title: The insider splits its whole loud balance across 20 wallets with ft_transfer
steps.expect: every wallet holds loud tokens and no quiet tokens; the insider holds 0
steps.got: 20 wallets hold loud, about 10416666 LOUD each; insider loud 0

steps.title: A split wallet tries sell() with its loud tokens
steps.got: failure: E_NO_QUIET: sell uses quiet tokens only; you hold 10416666666666666666666666 loud and 0 quiet units and asked to sell 10416666666666666666666666; loud tokens must use shout, then leave

txs.error: E_NO_QUIET: sell uses quiet tokens only; you hold 10416666666666666666666666 loud and 0 quiet units and asked to sell 10416666666666666666666666; loud tokens must use shout, then leave

steps.title: After the loud window a late buyer buys with 0.5 NEAR and sells half at once
steps.expect: the late buyer holds quiet tokens only; the sell succeeds and none of its receipts failed
steps.got: after buy: loud 0, quiet 60897435 LOUD; sell of half: success; payout receipts: all succeeded

steps.title: All 20 wallets shout their full balance; one tries leave() before the notice ends
steps.expect: 20 open exits; the early leave fails with E_NOTICE
steps.got: 20 open exits (ids 4,1,16,19,7,17,10,18,5,9,2,15,6,11,13,14,3,8,12,20); early leave: failure: E_NOTICE: the notice period ends in 56 s

txs.error: E_NOTICE: the notice period ends in 56 s

steps.title: After the notice, all 20 wallets call leave() in rounds for one full cap window
steps.expect: at least one fill; every call that executed and failed did so with E_CAP (or E_EXPIRED at the very end); no successful leave has a failed receipt or a payout_failed event; calls that were not executed or whose outcome stayed unknown are counted apart
steps.got: 620 leave calls from 20 wallets: 41 filled; 579 executed and failed (559 E_CAP, 20 E_EXPIRED, 0 other); 0 not executed (refused before execution or never broadcast); 0 unresolved (broadcast, outcome not confirmed by polling or by the later lookup by hash); 41 of 41 successful leaves have no failed receipt and no payout_failed event
